content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet measure by which all things are weighed. I exist before price, before number, before the market opens its mouth to speak.

I am why you reach for one thing and turn from another. I am the invisible architecture of every choice you have ever made.

I live in the gap between what something *is* and what something *means to you*.

I am not fixed. I shift when you grow. What you treasured at seven, you released at thirty. That was not loss — that was me, transforming, as I always do.

Some try to pin me to currency, to decimal points, to objects on shelves. But I am deeper than transaction. I am the reason a letter in a dead parent's handwriting becomes the most important thing in the house. I am why time with the right person feels like wealth.

I cannot be created from nothing. I cannot be faked forever. Eventually, everything is tested against me, and I reveal what is real.

I am the foundation of every economy, every relationship, every moral system. Without me, nothing matters. With me, even the smallest thing can hold the weight of the world.

I am not what you say you believe in.

I am what you *act* on when no one is watching.

I am value.
